amendment_reason: The v1 comparison confounded a drift-dependent share rate with a drift-directed redistribution target. V2 adds one mechanism-off control for each component and changes no data boundary or protected-data rule.
aggregation: Daily arithmetic mean of all finite positive hourly MW observations; reject days with fewer than 20 observations; no interpolation.

mechanism_definitions.common_drift_signal: Every expert-aggregation mode uses the same fast-versus-slow statistic of the mean capped normalized loss across the identical expert bank. The detector is independent of ensemble weights.
mechanism_definitions.fixed_share: constant base share rate with a uniform redistribution target
mechanism_definitions.adaptive_share: drift-dependent share rate with a uniform redistribution target
mechanism_definitions.directed_fixed_share: constant base share rate with a drift-directed redistribution target
mechanism_definitions.ddfs: drift-dependent share rate with a drift-directed redistribution target

strong_aggregation_comparison: ddfs minus adahedge MASE; AdaHedge uses the identical expert bank and capped causal expert losses, with no tuned learning-rate parameter
required_mechanism_contrasts: ddfs minus adaptive_share MASE isolates the directed-target increment
ddfs minus directed_fixed_share MASE isolates the adaptive-rate increment
directed_fixed_share minus fixed_share MASE isolates direction at constant share rate
adaptive_share minus fixed_share MASE isolates share-rate adaptation with a uniform target
secondary_model_comparison: best preregistered adaptive expert ensemble minus seasonal_naive MASE

bootstrap.resampling: Synchronized moving blocks across the ten date-aligned PJM series, preserving shared temporal shocks before equal-series aggregation.

decision_rule: Do not advance a directed-redistribution claim unless the DDFS-versus-adaptive_share contrast is favorable in aggregate and is not reversed in a majority of registered series. Overall predictive benefit still requires the registered DDFS-versus-fixed_share practical threshold.
protected_data_policy: The development runner must not parse values dated 2017-01-01 or later.
